item.tib: rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi snying rje la bstod pa
item.skt: Ar+ya man dzu shri ba ha ka ka ru na sto tram
item.coloph: rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi snying rje la bstod pa rdzogs s+ho/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pan di da d+ha dza rnga da na da dang/ zhu chen gyi lo tsha ba ban de rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o

item.tib: rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi snying rje la bstod pa
item.skt: ar+ya ma dzu shi ba ha ra ka ka ru na stod tra ma
item.coloph: rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi snying rje la bstod pa/ slob dpon 'phags pa slo grub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs s+ho// rgya gar gyi mkhan po pan did d+ha dzad rang da na da dang/ zhu chen gyi lo ts+tsha ba ban de ri nchen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa
